description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set
Chrome and Gold-Tone Finish, Vintage
This vintage writing set from A.T. Cross features the slim, elegant profile of the Classic Century collection, a design icon since its introduction in 1946. The set includes a ballpoint pen in the "Medalist" finish-composed of brushed chrome with 23KT gold-plated accents-paired with a polished chrome mechanical pencil. Renowned for their reliability and balanced feel, these instruments represent mid-to-late 20th-century American craftsmanship in professional accessories, offering a timeless aesthetic for collectors and daily users alike.
Set includes one ballpoint pen with gold-tone accents and one polished chrome mechanical pencil
Signature slim cylindrical bodies with twist-action deployment mechanisms
Presented in original black Cross box with red fabric lining and gold-tone label
Box dimensions approximately 7" x 3" x 1"

Twist mechanisms for both the pen and pencil operate smoothly. The presentation box is structurally sound with light shelf wear to the exterior. description:
Geoscience Industries
Introductory Earth Science Collection
2000, 75 Specimen Set
A comprehensive introductory geology kit designed for educational use, produced by Geoscience Industries in 2000. This collection is organized to teach the Mohs scale of mineral hardness and classifications for igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks. It serves as a classic classroom resource or a foundational set for a budding mineralogist, featuring a variety of textures and compositions typical of earth science studies.
75-slot display tray with numbered identification system matching the included guide
Includes original classification sheet covering rock-forming minerals and ore types
Bonus items: Handheld magnifying glass, large selenite wand, polished banded agate disc, and several loose tumbled stones
Dimensions: 20 inches (L) x 11.5 inches (W) x 2 inches (H)
Condition:
This is a partial set; approximately 40 of the 75 original numbered specimens are present, with several slots empty or containing only small fragments. The outer cardboard sleeve shows heavy wear, including a significant tear and crushing at one corner and visible staining. The foam protector and plastic tray remain intact and functional. The identification sheet shows light handling wear. Includes additional loose stones not original to the 75-piece set.

description:
Victorian Style
Glass and Cast Metal Inkwell Set
Late 19th to Early 20th Century Style
This vintage desk set features a substantial clear glass dome inkwell housed within an ornate cast metal frame. The frame incorporates a multi-tiered pen rest and is decorated with geometric and scrollwork motifs characteristic of late Victorian office appointments. Included is a coordinating fountain pen with a red barrel and black taper, providing a complete period-inspired desktop display.
Clear domed glass ink reservoir with hinged metal lid
Cast metal frame with integrated pen rack and decorative base
Includes fountain pen with red and black body and 14K gold-plated nib
Dimensions: 7" height x 6" length x 5" width
Condition:
Good vintage condition. The metal frame shows natural dark patina and surface oxidation consistent with age. Glass dome is intact without cracks or major chips. The fountain pen shows use wear; the 14K gold-plated nib has dried ink residue and functionality is untested. Note that small loose screws are currently located inside the glass dome. Hinged lid functions as intended.

description:
This lot features a small assortment of mineral specimens weighing 344.7 grams. Included are apophyllite, stilbite, selenite, apatite, celestite, and various other minerals. The collection contains raw and partially polished stones in colors such as blue, green, white, pink, and reddish brown. Specimens include crystalline clusters, hexagonal and prismatic formations, and rough matrix stones, suggesting quartz, calcite, aragonite, and more. Sizes vary, suitable for adding to an existing collection or starting a new one. They measure .5-2.5 inches each, due to the various hardness of each mineral scrapes, scuffs or flaking may happen.

*Grab bags /Assortments come as is with no refunds or returns.

*We are unable to answer questions about specific items within a grab bag/ assortment. Please view the provided photographs to determine general contents.

*Due to the nature of donations used items may have unforeseen damage not noted in the description.

description:
Natural Specimen
Clear Quartz Crystal Collection
Natural and Polished Quartz Mineral
3.5" x 3.5" x 1.5" (Lot Dimensions)
Unsigned
This four-piece mineral lot features a selection of clear quartz specimens demonstrating various crystal habits and lapidary finishes. The collection includes a sharply defined double-terminated point, a large natural terminated crystal with complex internal structure, a polished point showcasing vibrant rainbow iris inclusions, and a textured rough-hewn point. These pieces illustrate the high clarity and characteristic trigonal crystal system of quartz, presenting a range of textures from pristine polished facets to raw, natural terminations.
Features one double-terminated crystal and one specimen with visible rainbow inclusions
Diverse mix of natural formations and polished geometric points
Specimens range from approximately 2 to 3 inches in individual length
Total lot weight of 1 pound provides substantial presence for display or study
Condition:
Good condition overall with natural internal fractures and inclusions consistent with mineral specimens. A few small chips and detached shards are present as noted in the detail photographs. The surfaces vary between high-gloss polish and natural matte textures.
